title: The hub's six sections are not DR1's six: the frontend renames three of them, moves the contact address in with the other addresses, and puts documents fifth where DR1 puts them fourth.

finding.frontend: The task list is grouped as 1. About the consignment, 2. Commodity details, 3. Movement, 4. Addresses, 5. Documents, 6. Check and submit. The contact address is a row inside "4. Addresses" alongside Roles and addresses; documents come after the addresses; and within section 2 the additional-details row is placed above the identification row. The grouping is fixed in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:33-48 and the headings in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:18-25.
finding.prototype: DR1 groups the same work as 1. About the consignment, 2. Description of the goods, 3. Transport and arrival, 4. Documents, 5. Consignment parties, 6. Contact address (app/routes.js:5749-5841). The contact address is a section in its own right at the end, documents sit fourth between transport and the consignment parties, and inside "Description of the goods" the order is commodity details, then identification details, then additional details.
finding.difference: Regroup and rename the hub's sections to DR1's six, which means renaming "2. Commodity details" to "Description of the goods", "3. Movement" to "Transport and arrival" and "4. Addresses" to "Consignment parties", lifting the contact-address row out into its own final section, moving documents ahead of the parties, and reordering the rows inside the goods section. The DR1 sections also carry a heading level of their own below a "Notification tasklist" heading, which the frontend does not render.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub whose section headings read "Description of the goods", "Transport and arrival", "Documents", "Consignment parties" and "Contact address" in that order.
finding.verification: Opened the fe-hub and dr1-notification-hub DOMs and both screenshots and read hub/controller.js:33-49, hub/copy/copy.en.js:18-25 and routes.js:5749-5841. Ran the falsifier by listing the section headings from each DOM in order — frontend: 1. About the consignment / 2. Commodity details / 3. Movement / 4. Addresses / 5. Documents / 6. Check and submit; DR1: 1. About the consignment / 2. Description of the goods / 3. Transport and arrival / 4. Documents / 5. Consignment parties / 6. Contact address. Every structural claim checks out against those two lists and against GROUPS in the controller: contact sits in the frontend's addresses group and is a section of its own in DR1, documents move from fifth to fourth, and the frontend's goods group is ['additionalDetails','animalIdentification'] against DR1's Commodity details, Identification details, Additional details. RUBRIC 2 FIRED on the count: the title said the frontend "renames four of them" while the difference slot named three, and three is right — only sections 2, 3 and 4 are the same block of work under a different name. "5. Documents" keeps DR1's name and only moves; "6. Check and submit" and DR1's "6. Contact address" are not the same section under two names but a section each side lacks, which the review-and-submit and contact-section changes cover. Title corrected to three; every other slot untouched.
finding.correction: CLAIMED: the frontend "renames four" of DR1's six sections. TRUE: three — Commodity details for Description of the goods, Movement for Transport and arrival, Addresses for Consignment parties. CHECKED by pairing the two heading lists read out of the rendered DOMs: Documents is a rename of nothing (same name, fourth becomes fifth), and Check and submit against Contact address is a section present on one side only, not a renaming. The difference slot already named the correct three; only the title was out.

relatedTo.why: the same pass over the hub's copy and grouping
the missing heading is what the six sections sit under in DR1
